# engine_logs/

Start-up log excerpts of vLLM and llama.cpp engines serving public models under DGXMM on a DGX Spark, trimmed to the
lines the calibration and footprint parsers read (`tests/test_calibration.py`, `tests/test_footprint.py`). Engine
output generated by this project's test runs; host names, user names and addresses are not included.
